name: Pollinate Me: A Plant Dating Sim
source:
You are a bee, and you've been tasked with pollinating the plantfolk of the Graceful Glades – or risk them all dying off.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你是一只蜜蜂，你的任务是为优雅林地的植物授粉——否则就冒着它们全部灭绝的风险。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
